# Project brief for GitHub Copilot and other coding agents

## What we're building

**design.ai** (working name) is a web studio where signed-in users generate AI
images and videos with every model the Higgsfield API offers (Seedance 2.5,
Kling 3.0, Soul 2, Wan, MiniMax, Flux and more), pay for credits with Stripe,
and keep their generations in a personal library. It looks and works like
higgsfield.ai (dark UI, lime accent, left control panel, justified media
feed) under our own brand. We copy the UX, never Higgsfield's name, logo,
copy or media.

## Repository layout

- `studio/` is the Next.js 16 app (App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict,
  Tailwind v4, shadcn on Base UI). It started from Higgsfield's Studio
  template; read `studio/AGENTS.md`, `studio/layouts/AGENTS.md` and
  `studio/components/studio/AGENTS.md` before changing UI.
  - `generation/`: Higgsfield client, model catalog (one file per model in
    `generation/catalog/models/`, barrel generated by `scripts/sync-models.mjs`).
  - `lib/site/`: brand, model copy, modes, `?model=` resolution.
  - `lib/auth/`, `lib/server/`, `auth.ts`: Auth.js v5 magic-link sign-in on
    Postgres (Supabase). Server-only modules import `server-only`.
  - `db/migrations/`: SQL migrations, applied with `pnpm db:migrate`.
  - `layouts/generator.tsx`: the `/image` and `/video` generator.
  - `e2e/`: Playwright tests. `tests/`: Node test runner unit and DB tests.
  - `docs/`: `roadmap.md` (status, gaps, questions), `decisions.md` (why),
    `setup.md` (accounts and env), `ui-inventory.md` (higgsfield.ai notes).
- `tools/jev/`: developer-only browser automation (Python). Never imported
  by the app.

## Stack (locked)

Next.js 16 · TypeScript strict · Tailwind v4 + shadcn (Base UI) · Auth.js v5
magic links via Resend · Postgres on Supabase via `pg` · Stripe · Higgsfield
API with one server-side platform key · Cloudflare R2 for media · Vercel.

## Rules

- **Server boundaries.** The Higgsfield key, Stripe secret, database URL and
  R2 keys exist only on the server. Never send them to the browser, never log
  them, never log signed upload URLs or magic links.
- **Every server action and route handler checks the session and ownership**
  itself (`getSession()`), and returns 404 for other users' records.
- **Validate on the server against the catalog.** Never pass a model path or
  price from the client; model ids must exist in `generation/catalog`.
- **Never invent Higgsfield endpoints, parameters or enum values.** Each model
  file cites its source. Unverified models stay out of the picker.
- **Credits change only on the server, in one Postgres transaction**, through
  the ledger; debits and refunds are idempotent.
- **Row level security stays on** for every table with no policies; the app
  connects as the database owner.
- **No `any`, `@ts-ignore` or `@ts-expect-error`.** `pnpm typecheck`,
  `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` must pass.
- **Don't edit generated files:** `generation/catalog/models.generated.ts`.
- **Dark theme only; lime (`bg-primary`) is for Generate and active states.**
  Every visible control works; remove buttons that don't.
- **Commits are small and single-purpose**; tests ship with the change.

## Commands (from `studio/`)

```bash
pnpm dev            # local app (needs .env.local, see docs/setup.md)
pnpm db:migrate     # apply SQL migrations to DATABASE_URL
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
pnpm test:e2e       # Playwright; needs a throwaway Postgres (E2E_DATABASE_URL)
```

## Current phase

See `studio/docs/roadmap.md`. Done: catalog, generator UI, Explore, magic-link
sign-in. Next: server-side generation (platform key, generations table,
webhook, reconciler, R2 copy), then credits and Stripe.
